'''''The Acolyte: Wayseeker''''' is an adult [[canon]] novel by [[Justina Ireland]] and published by [[Random House Worlds]] on [[May 6]], [[2025]]. The novel features the characters [[Vernestra Rwoh]] and [[Indara]] and is set before the events of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]''.
